scope: irrigation decision/outcome chain, source review only

stages.authority: scene/provider lineage; no derived pixel is a field measurement
stages.acceptance: Verify radiometry, CRS, band grids, NoData and blocked Element84 paths against independent pixels

stages.authority: weather-service numerical ET0 owner; fallback stays advisory/degraded
stages.acceptance: Compare real provider inputs and FAO56 reference; preserve missing/degraded inputs without zero substitution

stages.authority: canonical field state/SoR, not a cache or a RAG narrative
stages.acceptance: Reject cross-tenant, wrong field/season, future-available features, and invalid soil evidence

stages.authority: water_ledger is a derived balance; recorded/unknown applied water must remain distinguished
stages.acceptance: Prove stage-specific Kc, root-zone, PM quality and inherited unobserved-water behavior in real PG

stages.authority: only governed decision record is an approval; RAG and estimates are advisory
stages.acceptance: Check idempotent candidate, unknown-water hold, approval and fail-closed safety gates

stages.authority: manual report is not actuator acknowledgement or independent confirmation
stages.acceptance: Check ACK vs intent, tenant scope, offline replay, same-event deduplication and failure recovery

stages.name_ar: نتيجة زراعية موثقة ومصدر حقيقة القرار
stages.authority: platform temporary SoR unless cutover gate is proven; outcome requires independent ground truth
stages.acceptance: Prove authoritative write, duplicate/retry isolation, late outcomes, mirror parity and cutover safety

stages.authority: calibration ledger distinct from model registry; ADR-0035 unlock conditions govern
stages.acceptance: Prove independent outcomes, season eligibility, SIM-GOLDEN and no production tuning before unlock

stages.authority: candidate dataset is not trained model, certification, or promotion
stages.acceptance: Check verified receipts, leakage embargo, held-out fields, external evaluator and independent promotion
